notes.title: Upcoming update - new levels
notes.content:
Hi!
We're working hard to get the game finished. Making final touches to the locations and tweaking gameplay. You can look forward to many new levels. 
Here are some new screenshots.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930274/a9e361192825bcaee595a4c47ded668e70938963.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930274/f0ccf3a8abb9b2794c9e1e87adbfae94fb333e7b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930274/f7162e9708cf0277114e6bd9ab2f79ffde34a02f.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your great support and  stay tuned.

notes.title: Upcoming update - new content
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930274/639f5e4fa6f789aca7ad2c28e3fa4e2b75f34b2d.gif[/img]

Hi guys,
the Early Access is going pretty well and we are working our ass off to get the game ready to you as soon as possible.
Thank you for your support, you're the best and without you, the game will never get this far.
In the mean time, we have prepared something to support our claims.
We added new creepy target, something, that should be real fun to shoot, but it you want to shoot mothe**uckers like this, you need proper tools.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28930274/909d213c8a2c9df6e1348ff3cbfca5ffed6dcf77.gif[/img]

Soooooo.... we also implemented the minigun for you to balance the score.
We're also working on new locations and other stuff that needs to be done.
So thanks again, have a great Xmas and stay tuned.
